T2M.name: Air temperature
T2M.definition_student: How warm the air is about two metres above the ground, roughly head height.
T2M.definition_scientist: Monthly mean dry-bulb air temperature at 2 m, spatially averaged over the returned grid cells.

T2M_MAX.name: Monthly maximum air temperature
T2M_MAX.definition_student: The highest hourly air temperature near head height during each month.
T2M_MAX.definition_scientist: Monthly period maximum of hourly 2 m dry-bulb air temperature, following the POWER Manager definition; regional averaging follows that temporal operation.

T2M_MIN.name: Monthly minimum air temperature
T2M_MIN.definition_student: The lowest hourly air temperature near head height during each month.
T2M_MIN.definition_scientist: Monthly period minimum of hourly 2 m dry-bulb air temperature, following the POWER Manager definition; regional averaging follows that temporal operation.

TS.name: Surface skin temperature
TS.definition_student: How warm the ground or water surface is, rather than the air above it.
TS.definition_scientist: Monthly mean model skin temperature at the surface energy-balance interface, distinct from 2 m air temperature and subsurface soil temperature.

PRECTOTCORR.name: Precipitation rate
PRECTOTCORR.definition_student: The average amount of rain and melted snow reaching the surface each day.
PRECTOTCORR.definition_scientist: Monthly mean daily rate of total surface precipitation after the MERRA-2 precipitation correction, expressed as liquid-water equivalent.

RH2M.name: Relative humidity
RH2M.definition_student: How close near-surface air is to saturation with water vapour, expressed as a percentage.
RH2M.definition_scientist: Monthly mean ratio of near-surface water-vapour pressure to saturation vapour pressure, expressed in percent at 2 m.

QV2M.name: Specific humidity
QV2M.definition_student: The mass of water vapour in each kilogram of moist air near the surface.
QV2M.definition_scientist: Monthly mean near-surface specific humidity at 2 m: water-vapour mass divided by total moist-air mass, in grams per kilogram.

WS10M.name: Wind speed
WS10M.definition_student: How fast the air moves about ten metres above the surface, averaged over a month.
WS10M.definition_scientist: Monthly mean scalar wind speed at 10 m above the model surface, not the speed calculated from monthly mean wind-vector components.

PS.name: Surface pressure
PS.definition_student: The weight of the atmosphere pressing on the surface, expressed as pressure.
PS.definition_scientist: Monthly mean atmospheric pressure at the model surface, without reduction to sea level.

GWETROOT.name: Root-zone soil wetness
GWETROOT.definition_student: How wet the soil around plant roots is, from dry to saturated.
GWETROOT.definition_scientist: Monthly mean model root-zone wetness index, with the root zone described by POWER as approximately the upper metre; dimensionless saturation scale 0–1.

GWETTOP.name: Topsoil wetness
GWETTOP.definition_student: How wet the upper few centimetres of soil are, from dry to saturated.
GWETTOP.definition_scientist: Monthly mean model wetness of the upper approximately 5 cm of soil on POWER's dimensionless 0–1 saturation scale.

SNODP.name: Snow depth
SNODP.definition_student: How thick the snow lying on land is, averaged over the month.
SNODP.definition_scientist: Monthly mean model depth of snow on land, in centimetres; distinct from snowfall amount and snow water equivalent.

EVPTRNS.name: Evapotranspiration energy flux
EVPTRNS.definition_student: Energy associated with water moving from the surface and vegetation into the air.
EVPTRNS.definition_scientist: Monthly mean daily energy flux labelled Evapotranspiration Energy Flux by POWER; retain the supplied energy measure rather than interpreting it as a water-depth rate.

ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.name: Sunlight reaching the ground
ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.definition_student: Solar energy reaching a horizontal surface each day, including both direct and scattered sunlight.
ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.definition_scientist: Monthly mean daily surface downward shortwave radiant energy under actual cloud conditions, combining direct and diffuse contributions.
ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN.source: NASA POWER / GEWEX SRB then CERES SYN1deg

CLOUD_AMT.name: Cloud cover
CLOUD_AMT.definition_student: The fraction of the area covered by clouds, expressed as a percentage.
CLOUD_AMT.definition_scientist: Monthly mean cloud-covered area fraction expressed in percent, supplied by POWER's SRB/SYN1deg source sequence.
CLOUD_AMT.source: NASA POWER / GEWEX SRB then CERES SYN1deg

AOD_55.name: Aerosol optical depth at 550 nm, POWER
AOD_55.definition_student: How strongly particles throughout the atmosphere dim a beam of light at a green wavelength.
AOD_55.definition_scientist: Monthly mean dimensionless vertical aerosol optical depth at 0.55 micrometres, supplied by CERES SYN1deg using satellite-constrained, model-assisted aerosol fields.
AOD_55.source: NASA POWER / CERES SYN1deg, MODIS aerosol inputs and MATCH
